resources.string: Type in the language you are learning. Your friends receive it translated into their language, and you see what you typed in a small window above the keys.
I type in (the language I\'m practising)
It gets sent in (my friends\' language)
There\'s no %1$s keyboard layout yet, so you\'ll get QWERTY.
When translation is off you type in %1$s, so the keys switch to its layout.
Language packs ready ✓ — translation works offline.
Language packs need downloading (about 30 MB each).
Slide across the letters to type a word, without lifting your finger.
Word suggestions above the keys. Ignores accents, so typing \"cancion\" offers \"canción\".
Fixes typos and missing accents when you press space. Backspace straight after undoes it.
Word lists: FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave, from OpenSubtitles, CC BY-SA 4.0.
Tap here and type with Language Keyboard

Tips: the ✓ key (where Enter usually is) locks in the current translation. Tap the language chip (ES → EN) above the keys to turn translation off and type straight in your friends\' language; the keys switch to their layout. Tap a suggestion to use it; tap your own word (in quotes) to keep it and teach it to the keyboard. Slide along the space bar to move the cursor. Long-press a letter for accents, long-press the space bar to switch keyboards.
Translation off: typing goes straight in
Couldn\'t download the language pack. Open settings (⚙) to retry.
\"%1$s\" isn\'t in the %2$s word list. Check the spelling.
Possible mistakes are marked. Fix them, or press ✓ again to use it as it is.
No suggestion. Tap ✕ to leave it.
Underlines misspelt words (red) and missing accents (orange) in the practice bar. Tap one, or the ✎ badge, to see the fix. Works offline.

Also checks grammar, like gender agreement and verb forms (blue), and explains each mistake. Sends the text in the practice bar to LanguageTool (languagetool.org) when you pause typing. Free, no account. Your friends\' translation isn\'t sent.
